carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature running horizontally along the posterior flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from a light-reflective upper edge to a shaded lower edge, terminating at the caudal peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: At least three distinct jagged notches or serrated tissue losses are visible along the leading margin of the ventral lobe of the caudal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark, slender, fusiform silhouette indicative of an attached hitchhiking organism (remora) is visible on the ventral midline of the caudal peduncle.
